# Teletext

Rebuilds the image from teletext block graphics: a 40×25 grid of cells, each a 2×3 mosaic in two of eight broadcast colors, or 1-bit white on black.

<EffectDemo effect="teletext" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { teletext } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/teletext';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(teletext({ preset: 'ceefax' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.columns = 40`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter   | Type    | Default | Range    | Description                                          |
| ----------- | ------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `columns`   | number  | `40`    | 10 – 160 | Character cells across the screen (teletext has 40). |
| `rows`      | number  | `25`    | 6 – 100  | Character rows down the screen (teletext has 25).    |
| `mono`      | boolean | `false` |          | 1-bit: white sixels on black.                        |
| `threshold` | number  | `0.35`  | 0 – 1    | 1-bit: brightness above which a sixel is lit.        |
| `separated` | boolean | `false` |          | Separated graphics, with gaps between sixels.        |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                      |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `ceefax`    | `columns: 40`, `rows: 25`, `separated: false` |
| `oneBit`    | `mono: true`, `columns: 80`, `rows: 50`       |
| `separated` | `separated: true`                             |
| `fine`      | `columns: 80`, `rows: 50`                     |

Apply one with `teletext({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/teletext`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Teletext (ETS 300 706) 2×3 block mosaic graphics in eight colors.

## Related

- [ASCII](./ascii) — Redraws the image as text: each cell becomes the character whose ink matches its brightness, in the original colors or in two theme colors.
- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
- [Palette reduction](./palette) — Repaints the image with only the colors of a classic palette (Game Boy, CGA, EGA, PICO-8, Commodore 64, NES, or four of your own), matched by perceived difference, with optional dithering.
